identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Oakland, CA: 'The Oakland Public Education Fund', EIN 43-2014630 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

Its own website says it develops and invests community resources in Oakland public schools, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts and the Measures N and H school-improvement budget item
Its own website lists an Oakland, CA mailing address and the same EIN shown in the registry
research.notes: Agenda text gives no city and no OUSD mention was found on the organization's pages; identity rests on name, Oakland location, and the public-schools mission. CA Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked (search budget exhausted, ProPublica search blocked).

profile.summary: A nonprofit organization in Oakland, California that raises and invests community resources in Oakland public schools. It works to support students in learning, growing and thriving. It has been a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) organization since 2003.

sources.title: The Oakland Public Education Fund - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda name 'Oakland Public Ed Fund' is the common short form of The Oakland Public Education Fund, an Oakland 501(c)(3) (ruling Nov 2003, EIN 43-2014630) whose mission is investing community resources in Oakland public schools, which fits a school-site program budget item; no similarly named organization turned up. Website, phone, email, address, EIN, legal name and the neutral summary are all confirmed on the cited pages, though none of them mentions OUSD, Measure N/H or Oakland High School directly.
